title: InvoiceGetRequest
description: The input of invoice.get: the invoice's canonical URI. This tutorial's own schema: the specification names it and does not define it (step 07's README, decision 2). NEW IN STEP 12: a URI, not a bare id, and an invoice's only. The pattern is the specification's resourceUri; the /invoice/ part beside it is this tutorial's (step 12's README, decision 1).
